discoveries.headline: Phoenix and Las Vegas surged 50-90% then collapsed as 2022 ended
discoveries.detail: Phoenix property prices appreciated 90% from Q1 2020 to Q2 2022 and Las Vegas 50%, yet Phoenix apartment prices fell 14% in April 2020 and dropped to -60 in the 2021-12 to 2022-11 slice. The Phoenix HPI trajectory peaked at 29.8% in December 2021 and turned negative in March 2023, showing the multifamily boom reversed across both sources.

discoveries.headline: Northeast and Midwest hold gains while Florida and Texas metros fall
discoveries.detail: In the 2025-09 to 2026-09 slice the Midwest averaged 3.5% and the Northeast 4.0%, while the South averaged 0.8% and the West 0.0%. Cape Coral, FL fell to -2.3% and Austin, TX to -0.4% in 2026-09, and the FHFA report shows Allentown-Bethlehem-Easton at 7% in July 2025 against Tucson at -2.15%.

discoveries.headline: Supply surge in 2023 pushed Sun Belt rents negative by late 2024
discoveries.detail: Mountain West rent growth fell to -1.4% and Austin rents declined by September 2024 (-4.5%), while the 2023 supply-ratio burst of 14 events in September-October 2023 coincided with Nashville's 7.65% supply ratio. Cape Coral reached -6.06% in the 2023-11 to 2024-10 slice, pointing to new supply as the trigger.

discoveries.headline: Rockford, IL leads the 2026 rankings at 9.9% appreciation
discoveries.detail: Rockford, IL reached 9.92% in the 2025-09 to 2026-09 slice and 9.65% in the prior period, the highest readings in both recent slices. Anchorage, AK followed at 9.21%, and Milwaukee and Fargo stayed above 6% in 2026-09, marking the Midwest and northern states as the leaders as the Sun Belt cooled.

discoveries.headline: Mean metro appreciation fell from 17.75% in 2021 to 1.48% by 2026
discoveries.detail: The slice mean dropped from 17.75% in January-December 2021 to 14.87% in 2022, 3.9% in 2023, 4.93% in 2023-24, 2.43% in 2024-25, and 1.48% in 2025-26, with positive shares falling from 100% to 70%. The steady decline shows the national multifamily and housing boom cooling over five years.

discoveries.headline: Coeur d'Alene and Boise hit 40% in 2021 yet Boise turned positive again
discoveries.detail: Coeur d'Alene, ID peaked at 40.6% in June 2021 and Boise City at 39.8% in June 2021, the highest readings of the period. Boise fell to -8.4% in March 2023 but recovered to 5.4% by September 2026, while Coeur d'Alene reached 4.5%, showing Idaho metros as the strongest recovery in the set.

discoveries.headline: Syracuse supply ratio of 0.4% matched its 2024 appreciation near 9.6%
discoveries.detail: The 2023 midyear outlook noted low supply ratios of 0.4% in Syracuse, New Orleans, Buffalo and Rochester, and Syracuse's 2023 supply ratio was also 0.4%. Syracuse then posted 9.55% appreciation in the 2024-10 to 2025-09 slice, suggesting thin new supply preceded the strongest Northeast gains.
